name: Sure Step
text:
**Sure Step**: Adventurers can spend their whole careers in the alleys and sewers of large cities or the tunnels of the Darklands. Characters with this trait suffer no movement penalties when blinded or moving in darkness.

Drow and half-elves can take this trait in place of keen senses.
